tools.name: gateway_task
tools.title: Run a normal gateway task
tools.description: Default tool for read-only requests. Pass the user's goal largely as written, including any website URL. The gateway selects the workflow, searches, filters, ranks, and verifies results. If agent_action="answer", stop using tools for further discovery. When presentation.action="open_result" and a browser is available, open presentation.url once for final inspection, then answer; otherwise answer directly. Example: gateway_task({ goal: "Find the cheapest green men's sweater on tentree.com" }).

goal.description: The user's normal-language read-only request; pass it mostly as written.

site.description: Optional public site URL or domain; a URL in goal is also extracted automatically.

response_format.description: Optional response size; concise is the default.

tools.name: gateway_echo
tools.title: Gateway echo test
tools.description: Confirm that an agent can reach and execute the Agent Web Gateway. Returns the received message without changing external state.

message.description: A short message to echo back.

tools.name: gateway_status
tools.title: Gateway status
tools.description: Advanced diagnostics for gateway health, execution state, connector coverage, and rolling metrics. Use gateway_capabilities first when planning a user task.

tools.name: gateway_manifest
tools.title: Gateway tool manifest
tools.description: Advanced route and contract diagnostics. Inspect the full or default read-only surface, schemas, current availability, and bounded route evidence when QA requires it; do not pre-inspect this for ordinary tasks.

surface.description: Return all tools or only the preferred semantic tools.

site.description: Optional public storefront URL/domain for one bounded compatibility route diagnostic.

query.description: Optional product query used with site for one bounded route diagnostic.

tools.name: gateway_capabilities
tools.title: Gateway capability planner
tools.description: Optional planner for a broad or ambiguous goal. For a clear task, use gateway_task or the matching specialist tool directly after WebMCP discovery; never inspect the manifest first. If the result is answer-ready, stop using tools.

capability.description: Capability group to plan for; defaults to all.

scope.description: Optional planning scope; use diagnostics or compatibility only when the task needs advanced inspection.

goal.description: Optional short description of the user's goal; helps choose the narrowest recipe.

level.description: Use advanced only when the task explicitly needs diagnostics or compatibility detail.

tools.name: gateway_find_tool
tools.title: Find an advanced gateway tool
tools.description: Use only for uncommon functionality not covered by the normal tools. Search the bounded advanced registry once; then use gateway_call_tool with the exact returned operation. This tool does not execute anything.

query.description: Short description of the specialist capability needed.

scope.description: Optional scope to keep discovery narrow.

max_results.description: Maximum number of matching operations to return; hard cap 5.

tools.name: gateway_call_tool
tools.title: Call a registered advanced gateway tool
tools.description: Execute only the exact operation and validated arguments returned by gateway_find_tool. Use this after advanced discovery, not for normal tasks. Unknown operations, arbitrary URLs, methods, headers, code, shell, and filesystem access are rejected.

operation.description: Exact registered operation name returned by gateway_find_tool.

arguments.description: Arguments for the selected registered operation; its existing schema is validated before execution.

tools.name: gateway_expand_tools
tools.title: Expand gateway tools by scope
tools.description: Deprecated compatibility shim. The fixed WebMCP surface is registered at startup; use gateway_find_tool and gateway_call_tool for deliberate advanced inspection.

scope.description: Advanced group to register just in time.

level.description: Optional explicit confirmation that advanced contracts are needed.

quickstart.purpose: Run an ordinary read-only web request without requiring the agent to understand provider routing.
normal_workflow: Call gateway_task with the user's request in goal.
If agent_action is answer, answer the user now; do not repeat the search, inspect diagnostics, or browse the source unless independent verification was requested.
If agent_action is report_partial, stop and explain the safe coverage limitation without restarting the same search independently.
If agent_action is follow_next_action, execute next_action exactly.
If agent_action is clarify, ask the user the returned clarification.
automatic_steps: Choose commerce, jobs, or rentals deterministically.
Extract a supplied URL and obvious constraints such as price, audience, color, size, stock, or location.
Run the existing bounded search, filtering, ranking, and finalist-verification workflow.

stop_signals.answer: The result is ready; stop using tools and answer.
stop_signals.follow_next_action: Execute the supplied next_action tool and arguments exactly.
stop_signals.clarify: Ask the returned clarification before continuing.
stop_signals.report_partial: Explain the safe coverage limitation; do not restart the same search independently.

rules: Leave a supplied site URL in goal or pass it in site.
Do not inspect the manifest or capabilities for a normal clear task.
Do not browse a source directly or manage acquisition tiers.

gateway_task.goal: Find the cheapest green men's sweater on https://www.tentree.com/
